content:
After an unusually long three-week wait, new beta updates are officially rolling out to developers, including iPadOS 27 beta 5 and more. Here are the details.

iPadOS 27 beta 5 and other Apple updates are now available

With iOS 27's public release still roughly a month away, the beta release cycle is typically about to pick up pace.

Apple today pushed out beta 5 of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and more.

Right now, only developers can download and install these new updates. However, if Apple follows its usual pattern, public beta versions of the same software should arrive within a day or two.

At this stage of the beta cycle, we don't expect to find any major user-facing changes in Apple's software. Instead, August is typically when two main things happen with Apple's betas:

  • New betas drop more frequently, usually once a week, but with fewer visible changes
  • Apple's focus shifts to bug fixes and performance improvements

Apple has emphasized that iOS 27 and the other new systems will deliver performance gains over their predecessors.

While that's already the case to some extent in the betas, expect Apple's new software to run even more smoothly in beta 5 and the coming weeks, with more bugs ironed out.

That said, if there are any new features or notable changes in today's updates, we'll let you know.

Spot anything new in iPadOS 27 beta 5 or any of the other updates? Drop it in the comments.
